title: Long handles
text: Long handles. Super long tongs, but super easy to use.  We have had issues with stiff joints in previous brands - not an issue here.  With the plastic, we prefer to hand wash.  Noticed with AmazonBasics kitchen tools that they use super long handles, which I am 2 minds with this extended length as it is cumbersome to fit in normal utensil drawers.
